metadata.title: Micron’s stock is dirt cheap — and that’s igniting a fierce online debate - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Micron’s stock is dirt cheap — and that’s igniting a fierce online debate
Valuation purists see a ridiculously inexpensive stock, but some semiconductor investors say Micron’s earnings power won’t hold up
It’s a tough time to be a P/E evangelist on social media.
Chip stocks have become far cheaper in recent weeks as investors continue to worry about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence buildout. But for investors who’ve pointed to the bargain-basement price-to-earnings ratios of stocks like Micron Technology MU and Nvidia NVDA, others haven’t been so kind.
